title: Book 7 — Polymnia, Chapter 105
paragraphs: Such was his reply, and Xerxes turned the matter into laughter and felt no anger, but dismissed him kindly. After their conversation, having appointed Mascames son of Megadostes to be governor at Doriscus, removing the one whom Darius had appointed, Xerxes marched his army on through Thrace to invade Greece.
